QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] To Handle Erda
QuestInfo.0: Write a letter to send to the Alliance about the information on the Arcane River obtained in Chu Chu Island. The letter can be made into a paper boat to float on the #bcalm water#k in #bChu Chu Village#k.
QuestInfo.1: The paper boat traveled far up the river of Chu Chu Island. ...Will this paper boat reach the Alliance? It would be great if it did...
